text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey ran in the Nihon Derby, 
showing off her Feng Shui-guided running 
style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey had said that her feng shui 
compatibility with the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby) was originally terrible. 
Yet meeting her Trainer seems to have 
completely overturned that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the Japanese Derby, a Feng Shui 
boom sweeps through society. Her dream of 
bringing happiness to everyone through 
Feng Shui rapidly begins to come true.
